For Jess,

a small paper thing, because tonight I cannot hand you anything real.

There is no anniversary today. No birthday. Nothing is on fire. You are just the usual amount of far away, and I kept thinking about you anyway, so I made you something you can keep open at your end.

keep going

The evening that did all the work

The sky put on an entire performance and we just stood there and let it. We took about forty photographs, because we both knew what was waiting at the end of that week. Most of them are further down this page.

Exhibit four

Open when you miss me

Sealed, so that opening it is a decision you make rather than something you scroll past.

I am not very good at saying this out loud without making a joke halfway through, and I am even worse at it on the phone, so I am writing it down somewhere I cannot interrupt myself and the signal cannot cut out.

Being with you made my life bigger. That is the honest version. I was doing fine before, and then u arrived and it turned out that fine had been a much smaller room than I realisd.you opened a window in it.

You are not an easy person to describe to other people, which I have decided is a compliment. You are funny in a way that takes people a second. You are stubborn about the things that deserve stubbornness. You are softer than you let most people see, and I think often about the fact that u let me see it.

People ask how we manage it and I never have a good answer, because the true one sounds ridiculous out loud: it does not feel like managing. It feels like the best part of my day is a phone call, and I stopped being embarrassed about that a long time ago.

I do know what it costs you, though. The bad weeks. The goodbyes on platforms. The evenings when a call is plainly not enough and we both agree to pretend that it is. You have never once made me feel guilty for any of it, and I genuinely do not know how you manage that part.

So thank you for the calls that run far too long, and the arguments about nothing, and the way you say my name when you are about to ask me for a favour. Thank you for picking this, over and over, when nobody would have blamed you for wanting something easier.

The distance is the only thing about us I would change. Everything else I would keep exactly as it is.
